correctness.rationale: Ordinary world-deleting announcement that neither S5 agent knows p is exactly simultaneous deletion of oriented incidence edges meeting vertices with zero current indegree or outdegree. For an arc e:u->v, survival to t is equivalent to existence of directed walks of length at least t entering u and leaving v, giving the exact disappearance time min(h^-(u),h^+(v))+1 when finite; cyclic walks give infinity. In an acyclic digraph, predecessor+arc+successor is a directed path with at most N arcs, bounding strict rounds by ceil(N/2), attained by an alternating bipartite path. If there is a directed cycle, the 2-arc (multigraph) or 4-arc (proper frame) minimum persistent cycle leaves at most N-2 or N-4 deletable arcs, attained by an outward attached path. This proves both sharp maxima including N=1 and stable-core cases. Independently implemented direct S5 partition-color restrictions vs oriented-walk recurrence for all 2,16,200,3600 labeled partition-pair/valuation instances at N=1..4, obtaining maxima (1,1,2,2) with proper same; finite checks corroborate the general induction.
